stories.title: Projecting Round 1 of the 2027 NFL draft: Who are the early-pick QBs? Which prospects are on the rise?
stories.summary: With the college and NFL seasons about to start, Jordan Reid projected the top 32 picks in next year's draft -- including a blockbuster trade.

stories.title: NFL axing Pro Bowl Games, will still honor players
stories.summary: The NFL is eliminating the Pro Bowl Games, instead shifting the focus to celebrating the honor of being a Pro Bowl selection.

stories.title: Sources: NCAA defectors can't play in NFL in '26
stories.summary: The NFL will inform its teams that any player who returns to the college ranks will be prohibited from signing with an NFL team this season, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Sources: SEC to suspend coaches who add pros
stories.summary: SEC schools that bring back NFL, NBA or WNBA players to their programs will face steep discipline under a new policy unanimously approved by the conference's 16 members, sources confirmed to ESPN.

stories.title: QB Castellanos commits to Texas Tech for 5th year
stories.summary: Former Florida State, Boston College and UCF quarterback Thomas Castellanos has committed to Texas Tech, he told ESPN's Pete Thamel on Wednesday.
